method.discovery: WebSearch over youtube.com only; /watch?v= results only, so Shorts never entered the pool.
method.verification: YouTube's public oEmbed endpoint. Title, channel, channel URL and thumbnail are copied from the response verbatim — no field is written that was not read from a response.
method.quality: Thumbnail CDN rendition probe; maxresdefault.jpg exists only for uploads of 1280x720 or better.
method.lengthCheck: lengthSeconds read from each watch page and /shorts/<id> probed — a 303 confirms the upload is not a Short.
method.embedding: youtube-nocookie.com embed, click-to-load. No embedding restriction was bypassed; a 401/403/404 from oEmbed is a rejection.
